$comment: Desired-state manifest for .github/workflows/fly-env-sync.yml (S-ENVTRUTH). One audited PR per change.
secrets: names only. Each is copied from the GitHub Actions secret of the same name (the workflow env block must list exactly these); unset/empty secrets are skipped.
flags: literal launch-flag values the workflow STAGES on Fly (values must be the strings "true" or "false"). Empty until the operator enables entries.
pending_flags: NOT APPLIED. The workflow never reads this block. To enable an entry, the operator moves it from pending_flags to flags (value only) in a PR, then dispatches the workflow.
Every name must be registered in src/common/env-validation.ts and prod-switches.yml; test/ci/fly-env-workflows.spec.ts enforces this.
